text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room before the spring<n>Tenno Sho,
Ines Fujin psyches<n>herself up by slapping her own
cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan and McQueen are running today<n>too, right?

Ceding victory in the spring Tenno<n>Sho would be
unthinkable for the<n>prestigious family. No doubt both
Mejiro runners and their supporters<n>will be giving it
their all today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go out there and get a<n>good sense of
how those two run.<n>Then I'll be even more
prepared next<n>time.
choice_data_list:
But since we're here, do your best to win today,
too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I hope you're ready for the<n>best service
you've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Ryan! Show the world just<n>how
incredible the Mejiro family is!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wow. All they did was come out of<n>the tunnel, and
the audience is going<n>wild...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! You're both truly wonderful! I<n>do hope
you'll do your very best to<n>claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I can see the sparkle in their fans'<n>eyes from here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So Ryan and McQueen get showered<n>with all this
attention every time they<n>race...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I get it now. This is what's it like for<n>them—to live
with everyone's hopes<n>on their shoulders!
